items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I would like to meet him.

ctx.x: I know him well. I know him like I did P. R. Gibson and Stuckey. And Vannels, you know. Yeah. Albino Red was playing with Ralph Hudson. He come to Crothersville, come to Steele, come to Hollins. And we still would meet again down in Memphis. He was another man with the left. He's the, with the dirty dozen there, Albino Red. He was, he would catch that day so fast, running.
Where was he from, do you know? That I couldn't tell.
